dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I like it! You'll only find buildings of this style in the Flower-Feather Clan. My own house looks just like this.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Don't be fooled by the rounded exterior. It's much more spacious on the inside than you'd expect.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Hmm? Looks like an onion? You really think so?
